tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Lichnerowicz's Theorem] 1. ch7:7-8↗ prob:harmonic-functions ↗ prob:eigenfunction-laplacian-inequality ↗ prob:bochner-formula Suppose $(M, g)$ is a compact Riemannian $n$-manifold, and there is a positive constant $\kappa $ such that the Ricci tensor of $g$ satisfies $Rc(v, v) \geq \kappa |v|^2$ for all tangent vectors $v$. If $\lambda $ is any positive eigenvalue of $M$, then $\lambda \geq n\kappa /(n-1)$. [Hint: Use Probs. 2-23(c), 5-15, and 7-7.] \end{exercise}
